propositions: Serena symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring a ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction asymmetry against non-deferred tools like Bash/grep
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is the only control lever and is global/all-or-nothing; no per-tool or per-MCP-server non-deferral setting exists
Loading all Serena schemas (~25 tools) to un-defer three named navigation tools costs a floor of 25,454 input tokens in isolation, or up to 63,852 tokens with a full MCP surface
The solution is a tracked .claude/settings.json with env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false and a .gitignore negation, plus measurement and revert documentation
Per-tool deferral control is not implementable with the current Claude Code API, so the original <= 4 tool AC requirement cannot be met
